$comment: Golden vectors for catalog.proto DISPLAY RESTRICTIONS (Ross, 2026-09-26; orchestrator ruling 2026-10-09), from 0.4.0. Every image and its mask are shown to every viewer by default, in the owner's own views and in links the owner shares. A restriction (rule id, level image|product|source, subject, scope) only withholds: every restriction that applies to the image and whose scope covers the viewer context withholds what its scope names, so what a viewer is denied is the union, whatever the level. `scopes` lists the valid scopes; a restriction with any other scope (a scope is recognised only as a key of `scopes` itself, never a name such as "constructor") or level fails closed: an unrecognised scope withholds the image from every context, and an unrecognised level applies when its subject matches the image's id, any of product_ids or any of sources. Subjects match ids without regard to ASCII case (A-Z and a-z only; no other character is case-folded). `image` lists the product ids that resolve to the image's head (the head first), every source it was captured from, whether it has a mask and whether the derivative has an alpha channel of its own; an image restriction's subject is image_id, a product restriction's any of product_ids, a source restriction's any of sources. `expect.image` and `expect.mask` say whether the caller is sent the image and its mask (mask is false when the image has none or is withheld). `expect.grounding_from` says what bottom_margin_frac and contact_band are measured on: the mask when it is sent, else the derivative's own alpha when it has one, else they are unset (and unset for a withheld image, which sends nothing). `expect.appearance_masked` says whether thumbhash and dominant_color are computed with the mask applied: only when the mask is sent. `expect.denials` lists the rules the coordinator logs as a denial, sorted by rule id, order not part of the contract: a denial is logged only when something the image has was withheld, naming the restrictions that withhold the image when it is withheld, else those that withhold its mask; an empty list means the evaluation withheld nothing and is logged at debug level only. `lists` pins the list a viewer is sent for one product: `images` in the spine's render order (the primary first, then the gallery), each with its `role` and `primary`; `expect.images` is the list sent, withheld images dropped and, when the spine's primary is withheld, the first image shown sent as the primary (primary true, its role left as the spine sent it: a role is the spine's gallery|other|thumbnail|user|unknown and never names the primary, which only `primary` marks), so the list reads as if the withheld image never existed; a spine list with no primary is sent with none. fc-coordinator's image-list chokepoint (GetProductImages, ProductCard.derivative_ids, any share projection) must agree with every case and list.

cases.name: no restriction, owner: the image and its mask are shown (masks in shared links by default)
no restriction, share_link: the image and its mask are shown (masks in shared links by default)
no restriction, anonymous: the image and its mask are shown (masks in shared links by default)
no restriction, an image without a mask: shown, no mask
no_display on the image, owner
no_display on the product, share_link
no_display on the source, anonymous
owner_views_only on the product, owner
owner_views_only on the source, share_link
owner_views_only on the image, anonymous
no_share on the source, owner
no_share on the image, share_link
no_share on the product, anonymous: withheld too, not signing in does not bypass it (orchestrator ruling 2026-10-09)
no_mask on the image, owner
no_mask on the source, share_link
no_mask on the product, anonymous
no_display on another image does not apply
no_display on another product does not apply
no_display on another source does not apply
a subject matches only at its own level
a product restriction on a merged id covers the survivor's images
a source restriction covers an image captured from several sources
no_mask and no_share in a shared link: the image is withheld and only no_share, which withheld it, is logged
no_mask and no_share for the owner: only the mask is withheld, only no_mask is logged
no_display wins over owner_views_only for the owner, whatever the level
two rules withholding the same image are both logged
a rule that does not cover the context does not decide: the next one still withholds
no_mask on an image without a mask withheld nothing: no denial, debug only
no restriction, a mask over a derivative with its own alpha: grounded on the mask, appearance masked
no restriction, no mask, the derivative's own alpha: grounded on its own alpha
no_mask withholds the mask, the derivative has its own alpha: grounded on its own alpha, thumbhash and color unmasked
no_mask withholds the mask, no alpha of its own: grounding unset, thumbhash and color unmasked
a withheld image with its own alpha: nothing is sent, no grounding
no_display and no_mask for the owner: the image is withheld and only no_display is logged
owner_views_only and no_share in a shared link: both withheld the image, both are logged
an unrecognised scope fails closed for the owner: the image is withheld and logged as written
an unrecognised scope fails closed in a shared link
an empty scope fails closed for anonymous viewers
an unrecognised scope that does not apply withholds nothing
an unrecognised level fails closed: it applies when its subject is the image's id
an unrecognised level fails closed: it applies when its subject is one of the image's sources
an unrecognised level whose subject matches no id of the image does not apply
an image subject written in upper case matches
a product subject in mixed case matches an id that resolves to the head
a source subject in mixed case matches
an unrecognised level fails closed: it applies when its subject is an id that resolves to the image's head
an unrecognised scope named like a built-in property ("constructor") fails closed for the owner
an unrecognised scope named like a built-in property ("__proto__") fails closed in a shared link
an id in mixed case matches a subject written in lower case
case is folded for A-Z only: a Kelvin sign (U+212A) does not match k
every upper-case letter A-Z in a subject matches its lower-case letter

lists.name: no restriction: the spine's list as it is, the primary first
the primary withheld from a shared link: the first gallery image is sent as the primary, its own role kept
the same restriction for the owner: the list is unchanged
the primary and the first gallery image withheld by their source: the next image shown is the primary
a gallery image withheld: the primary stays, the gallery closes up
every image withheld: the list is empty and the product absent
only the primary's mask withheld: the list is unchanged
the primary withheld by an unrecognised scope: withheld from the owner too, and replaced
a spine list with no primary: a withheld image is dropped and nothing is promoted
